title: [Decision] Large source files: replace the hand-cut split with a script-generated split per file, so the remaining monoliths split in days, not months
body:
director#1 · os-support-ai · session_01WGufzg12BtjFc5rHp7YD1J

Ruled: 6583399215 · letter A · 2026-11-02T17:17Z
Ruled: 6624174693 · letter (a) on the line-bar forks 6620288066 (#29985) and 6623247070 (#29986) · 2026-11-04T06:22Z · superseded by 6624258595
Ruled: 6624258595 · the forks go straight to (c), facade form, public API unchanged, with a structural gate, one window today · 2026-11-04T06:28Z
Ruled: 6624345766 · letter A on fork 6624324848: the .d.ts bar for the facade layer is "public surface EQUAL" (private members and their docblocks may change) · 2026-11-04T06:33Z

**Filing gate ②, a decision only the maintainer can make.** The maintainer, in the director session, after the director's project assessment: 「同意」 to filing the follow-ups, then 「我首先关心的是这么多大文件有没有快速分拆的方案」. ⛔ Not a claim. **Reader who acts:** the maintainer rules here; then the `domain:server` seat (engine surface), the `domain:spec` seat and the `domain:ui` seat, one card per file. This card does not reopen #24586 (ruled A, 6270097840); it asks whether the execution method changes.

## 维护者速读

- **问题**:拆分决策 #24586 已裁 A 并在执行,但手工逐个方法搬,太慢,而且有两个文件一直没开工。
- **实测**:`protocol.ts` 已落 35 刀,13 天从 33,065 行降到 25,055 行;`objectql/engine.ts` 21 刀后停摆,仍有 23,050 行;`sql-driver.ts` 系列已关卡,仍有 18,333 行;`conversions/registry.ts`(15,659 行)和 `StudioDesignSurface.tsx`(12,536 行,7 天 60 次提交)从未立卡。全仓 42 个非测试源文件超过 5,000 行。
- **推荐 A**:改为脚本生成拆分。每个文件写一次确定性的搬迁脚本,在合并前对最新 main 重新生成,不靠 rebase;验证是机械的,搬走的每个方法体逐字节与原文一致。先拿 `sql-driver.ts` 试点。
- **代价**:每个文件落地时,该文件要短暂停止派发新改动;拆分 PR 超过 3000 行,需要您逐个批准。
- **您要做的一个动作**:回一个字母(A / B / C / D)。

## Measured (`origin/main`, 2026-11-02)

| file | lines now | at its card's filing | commits in 7 days | card | split mechanism |
|:--|--:|--:|--:|:--|:--|
| `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol.ts` | 25,055 | 33,065 (10-23) | 85 | #25467, cut 35 landed (#28090) | class: body to section module, stub in class |
| `packages/objectql/src/engine.ts` | 23,050 | 23,903 | 56 | #25522, `pm:blocked`, "cut 21 re-priced, series spent, no PR" (2026-11-01) | class (`ObjectQL`, lines 5324–22355, ~278 members, 227 private) |
| `packages/drivers/driver-sql/src/sql-driver.ts` | 18,333 | 22,096 | 14 | #25521, closed `completed` after cut 21 | class (`SqlDriver`, ~268 members) |
| `packages/spec/src/conversions/registry.ts` | 15,659 | — | 14 | none (the `domain:spec` half of #24586's restart act was never filed) | table: 641 entries feeding `CONVERSIONS_BY_MAJOR` |
| `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/StudioDesignSurface.tsx` | 12,536 | — | 60 | none (crossed 10,000 lines after the ruling) | React component: not mechanical |
| `packages/services/service-automation/src/engine.ts` | 9,934 | 13,735 | 25 | #25222, closed | done |
| `plugin-security/src/security-plugin.ts` · `plugin-auth/src/auth-manager.ts` | 5,909 · 5,851 | 10,746 · 10,338 | — | #25223 · #25224, closed | done |

- Re-check: `git show origin/main:PATH | wc -l`; `git log --since='7 days ago' --oneline origin/main -- PATH | wc -l`.
- Pace of the hand method, measured on the one live series: `protocol.ts` lost 8,010 lines over 2026-10-23 → 11-02 (35 cuts merged, 68 `protocol-*.ts` section modules now exist). Each cut is a full dispatch: claim, dev, derived gates, review, merge queue. Cuts move from one member (cut 32, 10 body lines) to 22 members (cut 33). The two class series that ended (`sql-driver.ts`, `engine.ts`) ended with 18,333 and 23,050 lines still in the file: the easy seams ran out before the file was small.
- Why a cut is small: every cut is serial with the file's in-flight PRs (`protocol.ts` takes about 12 commits a day), and a hand-written move has to be re-verified by a reviewer as move-only.

## Governing text

- #24586 ruling A (6270097840): 「24586 同意A,是否建议这波分拆等 v18 发布之后再处理。」, one `[maintainer]` card per file over 10,000 lines, move-only slices, serial with in-flight PRs.
- Declaration-file bar for move-only splits: ruling 6348891160 on #25222 (sorted string-literal unions compare equal; no declaration added or removed).
- The 3000-line human-merge rule (pm-dispatch 〈路径分叉〉): a split PR over 3000 changed lines takes the final four-piece set and the maintainer's approval, ⛔ no Tier S exception.
- No source-file size rule exists: `git grep -n -i -E "max-lines|file size|god (file|class)|monolith" origin/main -- AGENTS.md docs/NORTH-STAR.md docs/adr` finds only package-level monolith text (ADR-0028, ADR-0029). No spec declaration changes in any option.

## Options

| | what it does | what a customer notices | workload |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| **A** | Per file, one deterministic codemod (ts-morph; `packages/cli` already depends on it) that applies the cut pattern the series already uses, to a whole section at once: method bodies move to section modules, the class keeps one-line stubs, shared members are reached through the host pattern. The script is committed with the PR and **re-run on the latest `main` at landing**, so the split PR is regenerated, never rebased. Verification is mechanical: every moved body is byte-identical to its source (AST text comparison in the script's own check), the declaration files pass ruling 6348891160's bar, type-check and the full suite run. Landing: a short pause on new claims touching that file, regenerate, land with the maintainer's approval, resume; in-flight PRs re-apply onto the moved code. Tables (`registry.ts`) split into per-entry files with a generated index, as #7297 did for the migrations registry. `StudioDesignSurface.tsx` stays on hand slices (a React component's closures are not mechanically separable). Order: pilot `sql-driver.ts` (lowest churn), then `registry.ts`, `engine.ts`, the rest of `protocol.ts`. The codemod is deleted when the programme ends. | Nothing directly. Fixes stop waiting behind same-file work within weeks; AI edits are made on files a reader can hold whole. | No precedent for a codemod split in this repo. Measured comparison: the hand series moved `protocol.ts` 8,010 lines in 10 days with one lane. A needs one dev to write and prove the codemod on the pilot (a draft PR plus the pilot split), then one PR per file, each a maintainer approval. |
| **B** | Keep ruling A's hand slices as they are; file the two missing cards (`registry.ts` → `domain:spec`, `StudioDesignSurface.tsx` → `domain:ui`); re-open the stalled `engine.ts` series with a re-priced seam plan. | Same as A, later. | Measured precedent: #23050 (18 PRs, ~6 days, one lane, 13,701 → 6,196) and #25467 (35 PRs so far). |
| **C** | A, plus a size ceiling on the split files that can only go down (a ratchet, as `check-skill-line-ratchet` does for skill text). | Files cannot grow back. | A plus one gate. 「新增门禁默认否」: ⛔ only if the maintainer names it. |
| **D** | Stop the programme; leave the files. | Same-file waits keep growing with the files. | None. |

## 四轴分析

- **项目长远合理性**:两年后核心协议层、查询引擎和驱动都应当是按职责划分的模块,类本身只是一个薄门面;主流框架都这么组织(NestJS module、Django app、TypeORM 的 driver 按方言与职责分文件)。A 和 B 终点相同,区别是速度和可靠性:脚本生成的拆分每次都可重放、可机械核对,手工拆分每刀都要人看是否只搬不改。实测手工系列在接缝用完后停在 18,000–23,000 行,说明 B 走不到终点。
- **实际业务拉动**:有。`protocol.ts` 与 `engine.ts` 一周合计 141 次提交,同文件串行每天都在发生;`StudioDesignSurface.tsx` 一周 60 次提交,没有卡。
- **防 AI 犯错**:A 最强。拆完后一个模块能被整篇读完;而且拆分本身由脚本做,不是 AI 手搬,搬错的可能被结构排除(逐字节核对)。B 的每一刀都是 AI 在部分视野下手工搬代码。
- **创业阶段不扩散**:A 不新增对外声明、键和门禁;脚本是一次性工具,项目结束即删。C 新增永久门禁,默认否。代价是每个文件一次落地停顿和一次您的批准。

os-decision-facets
- ① 项目长远合理性:A 可重放、可机械核对,能走到终点;B 实测在接缝耗尽后停在 1.8–2.3 万行;D 让债继续累积。
- ② 实际业务拉动:有——protocol.ts 与 engine.ts 一周 141 次提交;StudioDesignSurface.tsx 一周 60 次且无卡。
- ③ 防 AI 犯错:A 由脚本搬迁并逐字节核对,结构上排除搬错;B 每刀是部分视野下的手工搬迁。
- ④ 创业阶段不扩散:A 无新声明、无新门禁,脚本用完即删;C 新增永久门禁,须维护者点名。
Prior rulings read: "split" "move-only" "protocol.ts" "engine.ts" "large file" → #24586 A (6270097840), #23050, #25222 declaration bar (6348891160), #7297 (per-entry registry files); thread: none

自检:只看①选 A;②③④ 是否翻转:否。

**推荐:A。** B 不取:实测两条手工系列在接缝耗尽后停摆,走不到终点。C 不取:新增门禁须您点名。D 不取:债每周仍在增长。**置信缺口:** 本仓库没有脚本拆分的先例;试点前不知道 host 模式能否覆盖 `ObjectQL` 的 227 个私有成员而不改声明文件,这正是先拿 `sql-driver.ts`(57 个私有成员)试点的理由。若试点证明不可行,退回 B。

Analysis-tier: `claude-opus-5-5` (served at filing; not `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`).

## 裁后执行

- **A:** the `domain:server` seat files the pilot card (codemod + `sql-driver.ts`), quoting this ruling; on the pilot's merge, one card per remaining file into its lane (`registry.ts` → `domain:spec` per-entry files; `engine.ts` and `protocol.ts` → `domain:server`). `domain:ui` files a hand-slice card for `StudioDesignSurface.tsx` under #24586's ruling. #25522 is released into the new card; #25467 stops cutting once the codemod card for `protocol.ts` is claimed.
- **B:** the two missing cards are filed under #24586's ruling; #25522 is re-queued with a re-priced seam plan.
- **C:** A, plus one `domain:skills` card for the ceiling, quoting the maintainer's naming of it.
- **D:** #25467 and #25522 close `not_planned`; reopening is free.
